# Fixed places between the ends, and the line answered by all others

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`fixed-places-and-sole-lines` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](fixed-places-and-sole-lines.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Read with no fixed place at the bottom and top, every statement of place in the 彖 and the 小象 holds; no parity of the top place can. A line answered by all others is unique, rests on no place or phase, never lasts a step of waxing and waning, and leaves at the top to enter at the bottom.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The second relation of phase: lines 2 to 5 have the phase of their place's parity and the bottom and top lines have none (初上无位); a line holds its place where it is in phase between the ends. It is the phase of inPhase between the ends and says nothing at them. (`Becoming.Hexagram.betweenEnds`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Between.place`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.holdsPlace`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_end`, `Becoming.Hexagram.holdsPlace_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.holdsPlace_inPhase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.holdsPlace_ends`)
2. 王弼's dilemma: of two lines that differ at a place, every parity of the place puts one in phase, so no parity of the top place leaves both 需's top line and 乾's out of phase, as the 小象 and the 文言 say. The 小象's statements of place fix the parity of places 3, 4 and 5, and the statements of 中正 that of place 2. (`Becoming.Hexagram.qian`, `Becoming.Hexagram.same_comm`, `Becoming.Hexagram.one_in_phase_of_parity`, `Becoming.Hexagram.top_no_parity`, `Becoming.Hexagram.parityOf`, `Becoming.Hexagram.parity_of_statement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.statements_fix_parity`, `Becoming.Hexagram.centre_fixes_parity`)
3. The 26 statements of place of the 小象 all stand between the ends, and with 乾's top line (貴而无位) and 需's (雖不當位) all 28 hold under the second relation, with no exception. (`Becoming.Hexagram.all_sound`, `Becoming.Hexagram.all_complete`, `Becoming.Hexagram.all_congr`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placeStatements_between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.topStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placeStatements_hold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xu_top_no_place`, `Becoming.Hexagram.qian_top`)
4. The 彖's nine statements of the place of one line all agree; its five statements of the place of the whole (蹇, 漸, 歸妹, 既濟, 未濟) all hold between the ends, and only two under the six places. The configurations with every line between the ends in phase are exactly 既濟, 蹇, 漸 and 家人, and with none exactly 未濟, 歸妹, 解 and 睽. (`Becoming.Hexagram.tuanPlaceStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.tuanPlaceStatements_agree`, `Becoming.Hexagram.allHold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.noneHold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.wholeBetween`, `Becoming.Hexagram.wholeSix`, `Becoming.Hexagram.tuanWholeStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.tuanWhole_between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.jian3`, `Becoming.Hexagram.jian4`, `Becoming.Hexagram.jiaRen`, `Becoming.Hexagram.kui`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xie`, `Becoming.Hexagram.tuanWhole_six`, `Becoming.Hexagram.allHold_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.noneHold_iff`)
5. The phases between the ends read at their four places glue to a reading of the whole exactly where all four or none are in phase, so no frame of context-free claims fits them under any process. (`Becoming.Hexagram.betweenPhase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.allHold_sites`, `Becoming.ListTests.false_of_not`, `Becoming.Hexagram.noneHold_sites`, `Becoming.Hexagram.between_glues_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.between_no_free_frame`)
6. Configurations alike in the phases between the ends have the same lines there, so the falls, rises and alternations of the three inner seams and the opposition of the middle height are told by those phases; changing the bottom or top line keeps them and turns the opposition and alternation beside it. (`Becoming.Hexagram.SameBetween`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sameBetween_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.falls_iff_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.rises_iff_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_iff_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_mid_told`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inner_seams_told`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sameBetween_flip_end`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_flip_bottom`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_flip_top`, `Becoming.Hexagram.ends_not_told`)
7. The complement turns every phase between the ends, turning over takes the places between the ends to each other and turns their phases, and changing a line between the ends turns its phase; the counts holding their place of a configuration and its complement add to four. (`Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_reverse`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_flip_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placedCount`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placedCount_complement`)
8. Under waxing and waning the line entering place 2 takes the phase opposite to its phase at the bottom, and each phase between the ends turns as its line rises; the counts holding their place before and after a step, with the bottom line's phase, add to four and the fifth line's phase; a line rising from 2 to 5 holds its place at exactly two of them. The phases between the ends are not a lumping the law goes alike across. (`Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_waxWane_enters`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fixedPhase_waxWane_rises`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placedCount_waxWane`, `Becoming.Hexagram.betweenPhases`, `Becoming.Hexagram.betweenPhases_not_lumped`, `Becoming.Hexagram.betweenPhases_not_goAlike`, `Becoming.Hexagram.course_between`)
9. Two lines answer where their values differ, at any two places: symmetric, never of a line with itself, kept by the complement; opposition at a height and alternation at a seam are this relation at their pairs. (`Becoming.Hexagram.answers`, `Becoming.Hexagram.answers_symm`, `Becoming.Hexagram.answers_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_answers`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_answers`, `Becoming.Hexagram.answers_complement`)
10. A sole line answers every other line: it is the line alone of its kind, in a configuration with one unbroken or one broken line, and it is unique; the twelve such configurations are the uniform ones with one line changed, kept by the complement and by turning over. (`Becoming.Hexagram.others`, `Becoming.Hexagram.mem_others`, `Becoming.Hexagram.not_mem_others_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_answered`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_of_answered`, `Becoming.ListTests.or_left`, `Becoming.ListTests.or_right`, `Becoming.Hexagram.neither`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_count`, `Becoming.Hexagram.soleAny`, `Becoming.Hexagram.soleAny_count`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_any`, `Becoming.Hexagram.none_sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_unique`, `Becoming.Hexagram.uniform`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_iff_flip`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_flip`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_reverse`)
11. A sole line does not depend on place or phase: of the twelve, four hold their place between the ends, four are out of phase there and four are at the ends. Its configuration is opposed at its height only, as 節 is with no sole line; below a sole broken line is a fall and above it a rise, and no other seam rises or falls; a sole broken line at the top is exactly 夬. (`Becoming.Hexagram.sole_any_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.soleList`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_places`, `Becoming.Hexagram.heightMark`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_opposition`, `Becoming.Hexagram.jie`, `Becoming.Hexagram.jie_one_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.bottomMark`, `Becoming.Hexagram.topMark`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_broken_seams`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_unbroken_seams`, `Becoming.Hexagram.guai_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.guai_sole`)
12. Under waxing and waning no configuration with a sole line has one a step later; six steps on the sole line is back at its place; a sole line at the top passes out, leaving every line alike, and two steps on a sole line stands at the bottom. (`Becoming.Hexagram.soleAny_waxWane`, `Becoming.Hexagram.and_false_of_true`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_waxWane_none`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_six`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_top_passes`)
13. Censuses of the text: the three 彖 statements of 上下應 (比, 小畜, 大有) are sole lines, as is 履's third line, and 豐 has none; the eleven line texts of 中 all stand between the ends, five in the middle, and of the five of 中行 two; the one line text of 位 (萃有位) holds its place. (`Becoming.Hexagram.answeredStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.answeredStatements_sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.lv`, `Becoming.Hexagram.feng`, `Becoming.Hexagram.lv_sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.feng_no_sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xiaoXu_answered`, `Becoming.Hexagram.daYou_answered`, `Becoming.Hexagram.lineTextMiddle`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleCourseLines`, `Becoming.Hexagram.lineTextMiddle_places`, `Becoming.Hexagram.lineTextPlace`, `Becoming.Hexagram.lineTextPlace_holds`)
14. Along every run of waxing and waning the phases between the ends rise with their lines and are all turned six steps on, and the line from the bottom holds its place at two of its next four places; a sole line never lasts a step, is back six steps on, and passes from the top to the bottom in two; turned over, the run of the law backward mirrors both relations. (`Becoming.Hexagram.run_between_rises`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_placedCount`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_course_between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_between_six`, `Becoming.Hexagram.backward_between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.backward_sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_sole`)
15. Along every run of the change of one line, a step at an end keeps every phase between the ends and turns the opposition and alternation beside it, a step between them turns its phase, changing a sole line gives a uniform configuration and changing a line of a uniform one gives a sole line; whatever a run of any process shows, the laws of both relations hold. (`Becoming.Hexagram.changes_run_between`, `Becoming.Hexagram.changes_run_ends`, `Becoming.Hexagram.changes_run_sole`, `Becoming.Hexagram.between_shown_along_runs`, `Becoming.Hexagram.between_glue_along_run`, `Becoming.Hexagram.sole_shown_along_run`, `Becoming.Hexagram.answers_shown_along_run`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise: the places between the ends, the second relation, the answer of two lines, the sole line and the censuses are defined in the module; each spine law is used at its stated hypotheses (Contextual.fitsFree_iff with a place between the ends as home; Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped at the phases between the ends); the laws along runs hold for every run of the named process, and the shown-along-run laws for every run of every process on the configurations.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- What any passage says beyond these relations; the chapter's passage map states, passage by passage, agreement, exact scope or divergence, and its readings are the AI's. 王弼's text is quoted from the edition's paragraphs of his, not from 邢璹's notes, which the edition does not mark except in 明彖.
- The ranks of the places (貴賤, 尊卑); the ruling of the many by the one (治眾), the sole line's relation being symmetric; the other rulers 王弼 names (a middle line, a line in place, a line answered at its height); 時 read with 位; 王弼's line-by-line commentary (周易注), not preserved here; the 文言's statements of place and 中.
- That holding a place, answering or being alone of a kind is good, fortunate, beautiful or supports 生生; the module has no ethical predicate and no judgment.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Continues place-relations-in-context (Y2), which listed 初上无位, the line answered by all others and 王弼's 《周易略例》 as not done, on Ren's request of 19 October 2026, “我要你把这个系统完全建立起来，要变成库的一部分，要确保它在spine上有明确的mapping” (provenance, not warrant). The chapter on the 易传 maps 23 passages that cite this module: 14 agreements, 5 exact scopes and 4 divergences. Reading (the AI's, D53): the 彖 and the 象 speak of place by the second relation, and 王弼's argument for it is a law of their statements; 需's top line moves from divergence to agreement under it while the parity of six places stays as stated; 上下應之, 乘五剛 and 成卦之體，在斯一爻 read one line against all the others; 王弼's 主 is taken as that relation and his 治眾, 貴賤 and 美 diverge.

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [place-relations-in-context](place-relations-in-context.md). Reuses the places, heights, seams, the relations inPhase, opposed, alternates, rises and falls, atSites and the census of the 小象's statements of place; the delta is the second relation and the answer of two lines at any pair.
  - Output: The relations of the places at their sites, their laws under the changes, and the statements of place of the 小象 as a checked list.
  - Input: place, heightOf, below, above, odd, inPhase, opposed, alternates, rises, falls, middle, atSites, number, placeStatements, centreStatements.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [HexagramPlaces.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HexagramPlaces.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [hexagrams-on-the-spine](hexagrams-on-the-spine.md). Reuses the configurations, the received order, complement, reverse, flip, changes, waxWane and unwaxWane of Becoming.Hexagrams.
  - Output: Six two-valued lines and the laws of change on them.
  - Input: Hexagram, line, same, yang, complement, reverse, flip, changes, waxWane, unwaxWane, rising, allBroken, six_steps, run_six_steps.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Hexagrams.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Hexagrams.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [claims-shown-in-context](claims-shown-in-context.md). Reuses Contextual, Glues, FitsFree and fitsFree_iff, reading the four places between the ends as contexts.
  - Output: A frame of context-free claims fits exactly where what the contexts show glues everywhere.
  - Input: atSites betweenPhase, home a place between the ends.
  - Preserved conditions: Every context lies within its home (trivially). [Context.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Context.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). Reuses Learning.Lumped and Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped for the phases between the ends under waxWane.
  - Output: A reading the law goes alike across exactly where it is a lumping.
  - Input: betweenPhases under waxWane.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Learning.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean)
